result:
I fixed the UTC case in `anthrouter/pace.py`, so September 2026 now divides by 22 workdays instead of 23. The 53 pace-related tests pass. The full suite was still running in the background when I stopped, so I haven't seen its result.

**Cause:** `period_workday_dates` converted `period_end` to the local timezone and counted that date too. `period_end` is the first instant of the next month, which is exclusive. In UTC that made October 1 (a Thursday) a September workday. In timezones behind UTC the same instant lands on September 30, so they weren't affected.

**Fix:** the range now ends at the local date of the last instant before `period_end`. I also updated the docstring to say `period_end` is exclusive.

I didn't add a test for the September 2026 case, since you said not to change existing tests.
